title: Space industry production website with local media
prompt: Create a front-end-only premium production website for a space-industry company. Use distinctive local/generated visual assets where useful, maintain truthful proof boundaries, and finish desktop/mobile to production visual quality.

title: Payments dashboard high-fidelity concept
prompt: Create a separate Stripe-like payments dashboard concept, front end only. Treat concept as implementation scope, not permission for lower visual fidelity; include dense transaction states, filters, detail, recovery, and polished responsive behavior.

title: Local service asset and proof boundary
prompt: Create a premium local landscaping website using generated imagery for atmosphere while clearly preventing generated visuals from being interpreted as completed work, staff, awards, testimonials, or verified service areas.

title: Financial-regulated dashboard legal routing
prompt: Create a corporate cards and payments operations dashboard with sample data, role-aware controls, transaction review, dispute states, and explicit legal/security truth boundaries without inventing compliance claims.

title: High-fidelity concept mobile closure
prompt: Create a high-fidelity SaaS workflow concept with search, filters, editable detail, save/error/retry states, and task-complete 320/390/768 behavior. Do not reduce finish because it is a concept.

title: Explicit low-fidelity boundary
prompt: Create a low-fidelity dashboard wireframe focused only on information architecture and navigation. Keep truth/accessibility basics but do not spend scope on production visual finish.

title: Dashboard feature-depth closure
prompt: Create a production analytics dashboard where every P0/P1 feature has purpose, user job, information, actions, states, responsive transformation, accessibility, data semantics, and acceptance evidence; avoid metric-card-only depth.

title: Responsive decision report detail closure
prompt: Create a production decision report with evidence tables, risk matrix, action owners, citations, long identifiers, and explicit unknowns that remains semantically intact and readable at 320/390/768 and desktop.

title: Plural payments risk trigger
prompt: Create a payments infrastructure admin portal for merchant operations with sample transaction data, permissions, disputes, billing states, and compliance-sensitive copy. Treat payments as a financial-regulated risk trigger.

title: Visual finish after critic repair
prompt: Create a premium B2B technology website, run a first-render critique, repair hierarchy/spacing/media/state issues, and preserve structural differentiation when applying the final finish pass.

title: Floor-capable quality measurement
prompt: Create a dense front-end workflow and provide floor-capable evidence for usability, responsive task completion, accessibility, truth, and implementation correctness without claiming unsupported numerical PASS states.

title: Initialization with inline creation request
prompt: Initialize AIFENCE and in the same request create a production front-end-only premium dashboard concept for a financial software company. Do not stop after initialization; route and execute the creation immediately.
